findings.title: Sub-agent budget was enforced only after execution
findings.resolution: Added a parent-owned ExecutionAllowance to ToolContext and clamp every child RunBudget before dispatch.

findings.title: Remote tools could return unbounded output or repeat MCP cursors
findings.resolution: Bound all dispatcher output and added MCP page, tool-count, and repeated-cursor guards.

findings.title: Cancelled test commands could leave descendant processes running
findings.resolution: Terminate the subprocess session's process group on cancellation and wait for its exit.

findings.title: Locked pytest version had a published vulnerability
findings.resolution: Raised the test dependency floor to pytest 9.0.3, resolved 9.1.1, reran all tests, and obtained a clean pip-audit result.

findings.title: Filesystem confinement is not an OS sandbox
findings.resolution: Keep path and symlink checks plus exact write approval; require a disposable user-selected worktree and explicitly defer OS isolation.

findings.title: Trace redaction cannot classify arbitrary sensitive source text
findings.resolution: Redact credential-shaped keys and values, document the boundary, and keep trace storage local by default.

findings.title: Approval grants are not durable across CLI processes
findings.resolution: Persist run checkpoints but constrain approvals to the interactive process; defer a durable approval service rather than imply crash-safe approval resume.

findings.title: No SWE-bench or production quality result is included
findings.resolution: Local OMLX protocol qualification is now available, but is not SWE-bench or production quality. Such claims remain prohibited.

findings.title: Local browser mutation and rendering boundaries were incomplete
findings.resolution: Enforce local Host and same-origin mutation guards, hashed script CSP, explicit DOM lookup, textContent rendering, and safe upload/job polling. No public-network authentication claim.

findings.title: Knowledge answers bypassed authoritative memory-revocation filtering
findings.resolution: Supply SemanticMemoryService through Retriever to KnowledgeService; failed vector deletion cannot re-expose revoked memory through search or answers.

findings.title: Attachment hashes did not bind answers to selected documents
findings.resolution: Resolve existing indexed documents by identity before message persistence, preserve image/file ContentPart, and use bounded source-only excerpts. Reject unknown/unindexed IDs.

findings.title: Knowledge responses returned IDs without persisted run and trace evidence
findings.resolution: Persist RAG responses and actual request/retrieval/model/completion-or-failure events. Run lookup survives reopening storage and tampering fails trace verification. Ordinary chat is outstanding under FH-015.

findings.title: Persisted ingestion failures were reported to ARQ as successful work
findings.resolution: Persist storage/ingestion errors, raise bounded ARQ Retry, and disable result-key retention that prevented manual retries. Processor cancellation/replay is tested; live SIGKILL/outbox recovery remains unverified.

findings.title: Combined coverage could substitute incorrectly for required pure branch coverage
findings.resolution: Add an independent 85% pure-branch gate to make check and forge review. Fresh environment: 195 tests, 697/814 branches=85.63%, combined=92.36%. Negative tests reject a high combined score with insufficient pure branches.

findings.title: Full-platform conversation/context/run lifecycle remains incomplete
findings.resolution: Integrate budgeted history/knowledge/memory context and durable summaries. Give chat/memory commands real run/trace records, persist session citation/task state, and add end-to-end tests before closing.

findings.title: Controlled model/RAG fixtures do not satisfy all real-world qualification requirements
findings.resolution: Add annotated realistic screenshots/diagrams, diverse tools, strict raw-JSON measurement, cold/warm TTFT/throughput/memory, and representative real-model RAG claim-support evaluation. Preserve current reports under narrower labels.

findings.title: Full enhanced release lacks all required frozen integration/comparison evidence
findings.resolution: Offline clean-source checks passed. Complete independent same-data framework comparisons and in-flight worker failure/recovery, clarify or finish the PostgreSQL metadata migration, then rerun/bind all final live gates after final implementation freeze. No production HA claim.

findings.title: Personal interview materials are outlines, not completed learner preparation
findings.evidence: Personal knowledge base: 200 numbered questions and first attachment/trace lab
findings.resolution: Expand each answer to the requested timed explanation with evidence and traps, finish executable beginner lessons, and record three actual mock interviews. Generated materials do not prove personal fluency or independent authorship.

findings.title: Optional framework extra carries an NLTK advisory absent from normal runtime
findings.resolution: Exclude frameworks from normal setup and CI, avoid affected model-artifact APIs, retain advisory evidence, and re-audit before publishing comparison work.
